source_provenance: Lossless reconstruction from packed rows; not original authored upload.

mode_policy.mock_exam: One complete original set, fixed order; 12 sets rotate without changing official-style section volume.
mode_policy.random_practice: Level-specific adaptive pool; recent IDs are excluded and choices are shuffled.
mode_policy.game_regular: Lower band for the selected stage and TOPIK level; no repeated ID during an expedition.
mode_policy.game_elite: Middle-to-upper band for the selected stage and TOPIK level; no repeated ID during an expedition.
mode_policy.game_boss: Upper band for the selected stage and TOPIK level; no repeated ID during an expedition.
mode_policy.shorts: Only short vocabulary, grammar, and same-meaning MCQs are mixed into the curated multilingual deck.
mode_policy.review: The exact bank ID and displayed choice order are retained for retry.
